page.layout: One page of running text in a single column; right margin holds a short note beside the paragraph about Teutanes ("Teutane.") and a small mark near the top of the column. Printed page number at the top right; running head at the top centre.

main_text.p: tulas murmurantes. Nam canis capillis eas fuisse Aventinus refert. Quid si Druidæ etiam quasi d'runenden, id est, die runenden diffi fuissent? Similiter enim illi magi, & dæmonibus familiares erant. Alrunæ cujusdam magæ, quæ Clodomiro, primo Francorum in Germania regi vel primi eorum regis Antenoris patri, ante Christi nativitatem annis 433. vaticinata sit, meminit Sebastianus Munsterus libro 2. Cosmographiæ suæ. Hinc & mandragoram hodie alrunam vocant, nimirum quòd à magis illis ad suam magiam adhibetur. Nam quòd ritibus magicis canialli gata erui debeat, adhuc hodie quædam fabulantur: qualia de radice baaras Iosephus.

Coluerunt & Teutanem Germani, cui huTeutane. mano sanguine sacrificabant. Quanquam Iulius Cæsar aliter, lib. 6 Belli Gallici, Neque Druides, inquit, habent Germani, qui rebus divinis præsint: neque sacrificiis student. Deorum numero eos solum ducunt, quos cernunt, & quorum apertè opibus juvantur, Solem, Vulcanum, & Lunam: reliquos ne fama quidem acceperunt.

Sueviam continuum montium (Hercynij nemoris) jugum dirimit: ultra quod plurimæ gentes agunt: ex quibus latissimè patet Lygiorum nomen. Ex iis etiam Nahárvoli sunt. (Lygii Saevorum populi, inquit Althamer.

page.notes: Text in the bottom right corner is a catchword-like mark "E" below the last line; treated as a signature/mark, not transcribed. Several words are faint or broken: "d'runenden" and "die runenden" read as printed; "Alrunæ" and "Nahárvoli" uncertain; the last line is cut off at the page edge and the closing words ("Althamer.)") are not legible, so the final line is best read as partly illegible. "cui hu" ends the line and continues as "mano" on the next line. Right margin mark near the top of the column is a stain/fold, not a note.
